source.publication: 2025 IT-540 Louisiana Resident Income Tax Return Instructions (Revised 7-26)
source.section: instructions PDF page 7 code 01E; Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 40,000.00 + taxable interest 760.00 + U.S. Treasury interest 4,000.00 = 44,760.00. Federal taxable income = 44,760.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 29,010.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. No Schedule E adjustments. IT-540 Line 7 federal AGI 44,760.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 44,760.00 - 12,500.00 = 32,260.00. Line 11 = 32,260.00 x .03 = 967.80; the form rounds to the nearest dollar and gives 968; expected uses the unrounded formula to the cent. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 967.80. Projection: code 01E is not_modelled, so the Treasury interest is taxed. The booklet itself would exempt the 4,000.00: Line 7 40,760.00, Line 10 28,260.00, tax 847.80, so the projection overstates tax by 120.00 (3% x 4,000.00).
accepted_approximations: Interest on U.S. obligations is taxed (the projection cannot tell it from other interest).
The booklet rounds the tax to the nearest dollar (Line 11); the projection does not round.
